metric_definitions.f1_at_8: Evidence F1: harmonic mean of aggregate Evidence Recall and Evidence Precision
metric_definitions.gold_span_policy: include every raw gold span regardless of anchor mapping status
metric_definitions.matching: same source family and gold-token multiset coverage >= 0.25
metric_definitions.normalization: Unicode NFD + casefold + remove combining marks/punctuation + Unicode word tokens
metric_definitions.precision_at_8: Evidence Precision: relevant corpus context chunks / all corpus context chunks in the final selected context
metric_definitions.recall_at_8: Evidence Recall: hit gold spans / all gold spans in the final selected context
